_note: Meme token playbook — pattern recognition guide for Jarvis. Updated from 32 confirmed monster trades. Use this to score narrative quality and predict pump sustainability.

entry_signals_ranked.description: Website field on DexScreener = x.com/i/communities/... means a dedicated persistent buying community EXISTS before the token launched. Not random buyers — organised group.
entry_signals_ranked.evidence: Pluto the Penguin (+297%), every X community token we've seen has been a strong mover
entry_signals_ranked.action: Add +3 to score immediately. This is the strongest single non-price signal we have.

entry_signals_ranked.description: Token graduated pump.fun bonding curve in under 30 minutes. Normal tokens take 2-72h. Sub-30min = entire 800M supply bought in a rush = massive coordinated interest.
entry_signals_ranked.evidence: 7x7=49 (29min, +1547%), Pluto (11min, +297%), BURNIE, milkers, Dunald all fast grads
entry_signals_ranked.action: Strategy B should always attempt entry on sub-30min grads regardless of vol/liq on new pool.

entry_signals_ranked.description: Multiple similar tokens launching simultaneously ('Pluto is winning', 'PLUTO IS WINNING !!!') = a coordinated community is ACTIVELY promoting a narrative. The copycat launchers are trying to ride the wave of the original.
entry_signals_ranked.how_to_spot: A2 BC sniper sees multiple tokens with similar names in rug-word filter in short window
entry_signals_ranked.evidence: Pluto the Penguin — 6 copycat tokens blocked by A2 in same hour
entry_signals_ranked.action: If 3+ copycat tokens appear in 30min window for same name/theme, the ORIGINAL is worth elevated attention.

entry_signals_ranked.description: pump.fun description contains 'j7tracker.com' = professional launch coordination. Not random dev — organised group using launch tools.
Token creator has verified real-world following (e.g. pippin creator yoheinakajima = BabyAGI founder, 1.8M Twitter). Every AI news event triggers a new wave.
entry_signals_ranked.evidence: pippin — still active after 511 days, recurring waves on AI news
entry_signals_ranked.action: Check creator Twitter before entry. 100k+ followers = premium signal.

entry_signals_ranked.description: Solscan shows 'Axiom' as social channel = token launched/promoted via Axiom trading terminal. Axiom has a dedicated degen community that pre-coordinates buys. Same tier as j7tracker.
entry_signals_ranked.how_to_spot: Solscan token page social channels dropdown shows 'Axiom' at top
entry_signals_ranked.evidence: Freg (+1513% h24, Apr 05 2026) — launched via Axiom, same-day monster
entry_signals_ranked.action: Add +2 to score. Treat identically to j7tracker bundler signal.

entry_signals_ranked.description: DexScreener/Solscan Twitter field contains a direct tweet URL (/status/) not just a profile. Means a known degen is actively promoting RIGHT NOW — the tweet is the catalyst.
entry_signals_ranked.how_to_spot: socials[].url contains 'twitter.com' or 'x.com' AND contains '/status/' (direct tweet not profile)
entry_signals_ranked.evidence: Freg — @JakTheDegen tweet = active KOL promotion at launch time
entry_signals_ranked.action: Fetch tweet immediately. If tweeter has >10k followers: +2. >100k: +3.

entry_signals_ranked.description: Token hits TWO narrative categories simultaneously = two separate degen audiences buying independently. Political + horror, AI + animal, finance + cultural all confirmed.
entry_signals_ranked.how_to_spot: Token name/description references two distinct themes (check narrative_categories)
entry_signals_ranked.evidence: Silk Road 2.0 / Cthulhu (+1053%): political freedom-fighter + chaos horror. BURNIE (+2214%): gambling + political burn.
entry_signals_ranked.action: Add +1 for each narrative beyond the first. Silk Road / Ross Ulbricht = special: EVERY crypto holder knows the story = built-in community recognition.

humor_universal_math.description: Universally understood, requires zero cultural context. Anyone anywhere gets it instantly.
humor_universal_math.typical_pump_duration: Short and violent — 12-24h. Pure viral momentum, no sustained narrative.
humor_universal_math.exit_strategy: Trailing stop 12%. Don't wait for narrative catalyst — there isn't one.
humor_universal_math.red_flags: Multiple copycat tokens means you missed wave 1. Imitators dilute.

humor_animal_character.description: Character with personality. Penguin/dog/hamster that is relatable, cute, or an underdog. Pluto = demoted planet OR Disney dog = instant empathy.
humor_animal_character.typical_pump_duration: Medium — 12-48h if character has story depth
humor_animal_character.peak_timing: Often has second wave 24-48h after initial pump as latecomers arrive
humor_animal_character.exit_strategy: Trailing stop 12-15%. Character narratives can sustain longer than pure humor.
humor_animal_character.red_flags: Generic 'cute animal' with no distinguishing personality. Thousands of dog coins exist.

political_meme.description: Political figure or event. Works best when it's counter-narrative (anti-establishment, underdog politician, protest meme).
political_meme.typical_pump_duration: Strongly correlated with news cycle. Can sustain days-weeks if tied to ongoing story.
political_meme.peak_timing: Spikes on news events. boden revived every time Biden makes news.
political_meme.exit_strategy: Hold with trailing stop 15%. Political memes can have multiple wave catalysts.
political_meme.red_flags: If the political story is OVER (election done, politician gone), the narrative is dead.
political_meme.special_note: Liberation Day cluster: 8+ monsters spiked within 72h of April 2 Trump tariff announcement. Market-wide macro events = political meme trigger.

ai_agent_tech.description: AI agents, neural networks, tech founders. Works best when tied to real project or real person (KOL creator) with recurring catalysts.
ai_agent_tech.typical_pump_duration: Can be weeks-months if tied to real AI project. Pure AI meme = 24-48h.
ai_agent_tech.peak_timing: Waves on AI news events (ChatGPT releases, AI funding rounds, AI-related tweets from influencers)
ai_agent_tech.exit_strategy: If KOL creator: hold with wide trailing stop (15-20%). Pure AI meme: tighter 12%.
ai_agent_tech.red_flags: Generic 'AI' name with no project or person behind it. NUERO is borderline — no KOL.

gambling_finance.description: Gambling, casino, money-printing themes. Extremely direct appeal — people ON Solana are already gambling. Meta-gambling resonates instantly.
gambling_finance.typical_pump_duration: Fast and violent. 6-24h. Pure casino energy.
gambling_finance.peak_timing: Usually single massive wave. No sustained narrative.
gambling_finance.exit_strategy: Trailing stop 12%. These run fast and end fast.
gambling_finance.red_flags: Low liq at entry (<$20k). Gambling tokens attract degens who exit fast.
gambling_finance.special_note: BURNIE (the biggest monster at +2214%) is gambling/finance narrative. This category has the highest peak multipliers.

productivity_work_ethic.description: Hustle culture, productivity, elite companies. SpaceX = aspirational tech. fluide = flow state productivity.
productivity_work_ethic.typical_pump_duration: SpaceX held for days. These can sustain if narrative is aspirational.
productivity_work_ethic.peak_timing: Can have very delayed peaks (SpaceX peaked days after entry on Raydium)
productivity_work_ethic.exit_strategy: Wide trailing stop 15-20%. These are marathon not sprint.
productivity_work_ethic.red_flags: Company-named tokens need careful rugcheck — IP risk if actual company objects.

emotional_loyalty_cultural.description: Loyalty, emotional attachment, cultural icons. HACHI = loyal dog from Japanese film. pippin = BabyAGI creator's dog. Deep emotional resonance = stickier holders.
emotional_loyalty_cultural.typical_pump_duration: These have the longest hold times in our dataset. Sticky community.
emotional_loyalty_cultural.peak_timing: Multiple waves over days-weeks. Community holds through dips.
emotional_loyalty_cultural.exit_strategy: Trailing stop 15-20%. Give room for sustained moves.
emotional_loyalty_cultural.special_note: If token has personal emotional story from real person (creator's pet, personal connection) = exceptional stickiness.

x_community.meaning: Dedicated buying group with history pre-launch

j7tracker_bundler.meaning: Professional coordinated launch with bundled buys

axiom_terminal.signal: CORRECTION — Solscan 'Social Channels' showing Axiom is NOT a valid token-specific signal
axiom_terminal.meaning: INVALID SIGNAL: The Axiom entry in Solscan's Social Channels dropdown is a UNIVERSAL navigation element that appears on ALL Solana token pages. It simply offers a link to open the token on Axiom's terminal. It does NOT indicate the token was launched via Axiom. DexScreener sweep of 29 monsters confirmed zero have axiom.trade in their actual social URLs.
axiom_terminal.what_axiom_vision_actually_is: Axiom.trade/vision is a premium market scanning terminal (YC-backed) showing new token launches and trending tokens in real-time. It is a TOOL for discovery, not a launch signal. Requires login.
axiom_terminal.score_action: 0 — do not score based on Solscan showing Axiom
axiom_terminal.note: Removed from entry signals ranked list — false pattern. See kol_tweet_link for the real signal from the Freg screenshot.

kol_tweet_link.signal: DexScreener/Solscan Twitter field links to a specific tweet (not a profile) from a known degen/KOL
kol_tweet_link.meaning: A specific influencer is actively promoting this token in real-time. The tweet IS the catalyst.
kol_tweet_link.how_to_spot: socials[].url contains '/status/' — a direct tweet link, not just a profile
kol_tweet_link.score_action: +2 if tweeter has 10k+ followers; +3 if >100k followers
kol_tweet_link.note: A tweet link in the social field means the dev/launcher WANTS you to see this specific promotion. Check the tweeter's follower count immediately.

copycat_flood.signal: 3+ tokens with same name/theme in A2 filter within 30min
copycat_flood.meaning: Community is actively promoting a narrative — original token is the target
copycat_flood.score_action: Flag original token for elevated monitoring

kol_creator.signal: Creator wallet matches known KOL Twitter account
kol_creator.meaning: Every tweet from that person = new wave catalyst

dual_narrative.signal: Token name/description hits TWO distinct narrative categories simultaneously
dual_narrative.meaning: Two separate audiences can pump the same token independently. Political + horror, AI + finance, animal + KOL all proven.
examples: Silk Road 2.0 / Cthulhu (+1053%): political counter-establishment + chaos/horror culture
OPK/Obi PNut Kenobi (+191%): political (PNut squirrel) + Star Wars cultural
dual_narrative.score_action: +1 per additional narrative category beyond the first (max +2)
dual_narrative.note: The Silk Road narrative is uniquely powerful in crypto — Ross Ulbricht story resonates with EVERY crypto holder. Any token referencing Silk Road/Ross/dark web freedom has built-in community recognition.

wave_patterns.description: Meme tokens typically have 2-3 waves. Our entry strategy targets Wave 1. If we miss Wave 1, wait for Wave 2 setup — never enter during Wave 1 peak.

wave_1.action: ENTER — this is monster DNA entry conditions

wave_1_peak.action: DO NOT ENTER — we have missed wave 1. Wait or skip.

correction.characteristics: h1 coming down from 200%+ to 50-80%, m5 negative, buy_ratio 45-55%
correction.action: DANGER ZONE — could be dead cat or wave 2 setup. Wait for buy_ratio to stabilise above 55%.

wave_2_setup.characteristics: h1 reset to 50-100% after correction, m5: 0-10%, buy_ratio: 55-62%, vol still active
wave_2_setup.action: POSSIBLE entry — use 12% trailing stop, accept that this is higher risk than wave 1

red_flags_never_enter: Buy ratio h1 > 70% — euphoric top buyers, exits will be brutal (FML=69.9% rugged, apple=79.8% rugged)
m5 > 15% — already running, we're late (our #1 loss driver)
h1 > 80% on first wave — pump exhausted, exit liquidity risk
Vol/liq > 8x — wash trading or post-peak frenzy
Token has freeze authority AND no socials — silent rug
Multiple identical tokens flooding A2 WITH DIFFERENT MINTS for same name — competing rugs, not coordination

macro_event_boost.description: Macro market events act as catalysts for political meme tokens especially. 8 of 32 monsters spiked within 72h of April 2 2026 Liberation Day tariff announcement.
confirmed_catalysts: Liberation Day tariffs (April 2 2026) — triggered political meme wave
Biden/Trump news events — boden revival pattern
AI model releases — pippin, ELUN, NUERO wave triggers
Any viral animal story — HACHI, Hamster, PNut/OPK pattern
macro_event_boost.action: When macro_event_mode=true, raise score threshold for political/AI narrative tokens by -2 (easier entry). Normal tokens unchanged.

exit_by_narrative.pure_humor: Trailing stop 12%. These are sprints. Don't overstay.
exit_by_narrative.animal_character: Trailing stop 12-15%. Can have wave 2, but don't count on it.
exit_by_narrative.political_meme: Trailing stop 15%. News cycle can extend. But if story ends, so does the trade.
exit_by_narrative.ai_tech: Trailing stop 15-20% if KOL creator, 12% if no KOL.
exit_by_narrative.gambling_finance: Trailing stop 12%. Fast in, fast out.
exit_by_narrative.emotional_loyalty: Trailing stop 15-20%. These are marathon tokens. Give them room.
exit_by_narrative.productivity_aspirational: Trailing stop 20%. SpaceX/fluide showed these can run for days.
